name: Menu focus and events for keyboard and gamepad
body: Elements with onRelease or onPress are focusable, in tree order. The game names its navigation actions once (GameUi:::SetNavigation); the engine moves focus on their edges, calls onFocus on the newly focused element and onRelease on confirm. A focused element is drawn with its :hover style.
questions: Mouse support: the input snapshot has no cursor position yet, so menus are keyboard and gamepad only. Add pointer hover and click later?
